facets.representation: Opaque PRIVATE_SOURCE artifact binding plus exact checksum; bytes remain outside the managed JSON.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: Artifact status UNKNOWN is explicit when no private ref is available.
facets.loss_policy: Missing or unreadable source bytes require an accounted blocking loss.

facets.representation: The private source artifact may resolve private filename metadata; the filename is never copied into safe content.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: An unresolved private artifact remains status UNKNOWN without guessed filename.
facets.loss_policy: Unrecoverable filename loss is recorded as PRIVATE_SOURCE loss only when filename retention is required.

facets.representation: Closed source format enum with typed source details.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: UNKNOWN format carries an explicit reason.
facets.loss_policy: Format ambiguity is an issue and may become a blocking loss when parsing cannot continue.

facets.representation: Status-bearing metadata value with origin and evidence anchors.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: UNKNOWN stores null value and no fabricated candidate.
facets.loss_policy: Required but unavailable type context is recorded in the loss ledger.

facets.representation: Status-bearing title value with provenance.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: UNKNOWN is valid and requires no value.
facets.loss_policy: A lost visible title is an accounted CONTENT loss.

facets.representation: Status-bearing issuer value with provenance.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: UNKNOWN is valid and requires no value.
facets.loss_policy: A lost visible issuer is an accounted CONTENT loss.

facets.representation: Status-bearing owner/account field; private values remain governed content.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: UNKNOWN stores no guessed owner or account.
facets.loss_policy: A lost visible relation is an accounted CONTENT or RELATION loss.

facets.representation: Status-bearing literal date value with explicit origin.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: UNKNOWN stores null value.
facets.loss_policy: Unrecoverable visible date context is an accounted CONTENT loss.

facets.representation: Status-bearing literal reporting-period value with anchors.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: UNKNOWN stores null value.
facets.loss_policy: Unrecoverable visible period context is an accounted CONTENT loss.

facets.representation: Status-bearing language metadata with source or deterministic origin.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: UNKNOWN stores no inferred language.
facets.loss_policy: Loss is recorded only when missing language blocks a declared consumer.

facets.representation: Source part count plus PAGE boundaries.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: Unavailable count requires explicit source issue; it is never guessed.
facets.loss_policy: Incomplete page inventory is an ORDER or PROVENANCE loss.

facets.representation: PAGE boundaries live in the sole ordered block stream.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: Unknown internal page content becomes UNKNOWN blocks without changing boundary order.
facets.loss_policy: Missing or ambiguous page order is an accounted ORDER loss.

facets.representation: HEADING block retains source-normalized raw text.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: Uncertain classification may use UNKNOWN block; uncertain level remains HEADING with level_status UNKNOWN.
facets.loss_policy: Lost heading text is an accounted CONTENT loss.

facets.representation: Optional logical heading level plus KNOWN or UNKNOWN status.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: UNKNOWN level requires null rather than a guessed number.
facets.loss_policy: Required but unrecoverable level is an accounted STRUCTURE loss.

facets.representation: Section heading remains in order; explicit membership uses BELONGS_TO_SECTION.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: No relation is invented from proximity; uncertain relation is UNKNOWN_RELATION.
facets.loss_policy: Known but unrecoverable section membership is an accounted RELATION loss.

facets.representation: Heading levels and explicit relations express nested source sections without a graph-first model.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: Unknown level or membership remains explicit.
facets.loss_policy: Lost subsection hierarchy is an accounted STRUCTURE or RELATION loss.

facets.representation: Each paragraph is one ordered block; line and word joins are recorded.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: Uncertain joins use status UNCERTAIN.
facets.loss_policy: Merged or split boundaries that cannot be restored are accounted STRUCTURE losses.

facets.representation: LIST keeps item order and optional nesting.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: Unknown nesting uses null plus nesting_status UNKNOWN.
facets.loss_policy: Lost list membership/order is an accounted STRUCTURE loss.

facets.representation: NOTE is a first-class ordered block; target relation is explicit.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: Unknown note kind is allowed; target is not guessed.
facets.loss_policy: Missing text or target is an accounted CONTENT or RELATION loss.

facets.representation: Footnote text remains ordered and can target a block, row or cell.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: Uncertain target remains UNKNOWN_RELATION.
facets.loss_policy: Missing text or binding is an accounted CONTENT or RELATION loss.

facets.representation: PAGE boundary is an ordered content block, not a section surrogate.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: Unknown page content does not remove the boundary.
facets.loss_policy: Missing source boundary is an accounted ORDER loss.

facets.representation: VISUAL keeps caption, safe description, processing status and PRIVATE_SOURCE artifact ref.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: Unknown visual type or description remains status UNKNOWN; source artifact is not deleted.
facets.loss_policy: Unavailable image bytes or caption are accounted PRIVATE_SOURCE or CONTENT losses.

facets.representation: UNKNOWN retains raw text and/or private artifact ref, reason, ordinal and anchors.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: UNKNOWN is mandatory for unfamiliar structures and never fails merely because structure is new.
facets.loss_policy: Any unavailable portion is separately recorded in the loss ledger.

facets.representation: blocks[] is the single contiguous reading order across all block types.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: An unclassified element occupies its source ordinal as UNKNOWN.
facets.loss_policy: Any unrecoverable ordering ambiguity is an accounted ORDER loss.

facets.representation: TABLE is one ordered block around the existing description plus rows core.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: Unknown table structure remains in optional UNKNOWN-status layers.
facets.loss_policy: Unavailable table content or grouping is accounted without fabricating cells.

facets.representation: Status-bearing title with origin and evidence anchors.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: UNKNOWN title uses null and no guess.
facets.loss_policy: Known lost title is an accounted CONTENT loss.

facets.representation: Table position is its block ordinal plus source anchors.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: Unknown table structure does not erase its ordinal or anchors.
facets.loss_policy: Ambiguous placement is an accounted ORDER loss.

facets.representation: Preceding text is the earlier PARAGRAPH, HEADING, LIST, NOTE or UNKNOWN block in the same stream.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: Unclassified preceding material remains UNKNOWN in place.
facets.loss_policy: Missing preceding text is an accounted CONTENT loss.

facets.representation: Following text is the later ordered block in the same stream.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: Unclassified following material remains UNKNOWN in place.
facets.loss_policy: Missing following text is an accounted CONTENT loss.

facets.representation: Literal header strings remain in rows; optional logical header annotations add roles.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: Header hierarchy may be UNKNOWN without modifying literal rows.
facets.loss_policy: Unreadable header text or mapping is accounted.

facets.representation: Logical levels and logical column ranges are optional annotations, not physical merge claims.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: UNKNOWN hierarchy carries an empty entries list.
facets.loss_policy: Known but unrecoverable hierarchy is an accounted STRUCTURE loss.

facets.representation: Array order is logical row order.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: Unknown row roles do not alter row position.
facets.loss_policy: Missing/reordered rows are accounted ORDER losses.

facets.representation: Visible strings and nulls retain the proven logical table core; annotations qualify cell state.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: UNKNOWN cell state is explicit and never fabricates text.
facets.loss_policy: Unreadable value is a null plus UNREADABLE annotation and accounted loss when text is lost.

facets.representation: Source-visible row-label strings remain literal row cells.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: No semantic row-label role is guessed.
facets.loss_policy: Lost label text is an accounted CONTENT loss.

facets.representation: Optional logical groups reference inclusive logical row ranges.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: UNKNOWN group status permits no invented groups.
facets.loss_policy: Known but unrecoverable groups are accounted STRUCTURE losses.

facets.representation: null remains in rows and EMPTY annotation distinguishes deliberate blank state.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: UNKNOWN is distinct from EMPTY.
facets.loss_policy: Ambiguous blank/unreadable source state is accounted if it cannot be resolved.

facets.representation: Literal total row remains in rows; optional TOTAL marker records known role.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: Unknown role is not promoted to TOTAL.
facets.loss_policy: Lost role or row is an accounted STRUCTURE or CONTENT loss.

facets.representation: SUBTOTAL marker targets a logical row with explicit origin.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: UNKNOWN marker avoids inferred subtotal meaning.
facets.loss_policy: Known but unrecoverable subtotal role is an accounted STRUCTURE loss.

facets.representation: Unit label binds to logical column indexes with status and origin.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: Unknown unit label or binding remains UNKNOWN.
facets.loss_policy: Known lost unit binding is an accounted RELATION loss.

facets.representation: Note is ordered content; NOTE_FOR binds it to the table.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: Uncertain binding is UNKNOWN_RELATION.
facets.loss_policy: Missing note text or binding is accounted.

facets.representation: Footnote can target the table, logical row or logical cell.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: Uncertain target is not guessed.
facets.loss_policy: Missing footnote text or target is accounted.

facets.representation: A later TABLE block may explicitly continue an earlier TABLE block.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: No continuation is inferred solely from adjacency or repeated headers.
facets.loss_policy: Known but unrecoverable continuation is an accounted RELATION loss.

facets.representation: Both directed continuation and symmetric logical-object relation shapes are supported.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: Ambiguous relationship remains UNKNOWN_RELATION.
facets.loss_policy: Known missing relation is accounted.

facets.representation: EMPTY and UNREADABLE are distinct states over the unchanged rows array.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: UNKNOWN remains a third non-assertive state.
facets.loss_policy: UNREADABLE text is recorded in the loss ledger when source content was lost.

facets.representation: PDF anchor page and PAGE boundary preserve page identity.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: Unknown content still retains the page anchor.
facets.loss_policy: Unavailable page identity is an accounted PROVENANCE loss.

facets.representation: Contiguous zero-based ordinal is mandatory and validator-enforced.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: UNKNOWN block receives the same ordinal discipline.
facets.loss_policy: Ambiguous source order is an accounted ORDER loss; validator never renumbers silently.

facets.representation: Typed PDF, HTML, CSV, XLSX, XLS and UNKNOWN locators remain provenance-only.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: Private or unknown locators use explicit PRIVATE_SOURCE status rather than guessed coordinates.
facets.loss_policy: Unavailable required locator is an accounted PROVENANCE loss.

facets.representation: Stable opaque refs bind document and anchors to source artifacts.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: Unknown ref status is explicit.
facets.loss_policy: Broken required ref is a blocking PROVENANCE loss.

facets.representation: Source, anchor and canonical-document integrity hashes are explicit.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: A missing required source checksum fails schema rather than becoming guessed.
facets.loss_policy: Checksum mismatch is a terminal contract error, not a soft loss.

facets.representation: Opaque PRIVATE_SOURCE artifact binding links to the retained source without exposing a path.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: UNKNOWN ref is explicit.
facets.loss_policy: Unavailable required source link is an accounted blocking loss.

facets.representation: Rows are structurally contained by exactly one TABLE content object.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: Unknown row role does not break containment.
facets.loss_policy: Detached or missing rows fail the table contract or are accounted as content loss.

facets.representation: Explicit relation points from TABLE block to section HEADING block.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: Unknown membership is not inferred from proximity.
facets.loss_policy: Known missing membership is an accounted RELATION loss.

facets.representation: Every section heading is contained in exactly one document's sole block stream; optional child membership uses relations.
facets.explicit_unknown_policy: Unknown hierarchy does not remove document containment.
facets.loss_policy: Missing section block or hierarchy is accounted as CONTENT or STRUCTURE loss.
